name: CLI-Anything
description: Drive LibreOffice, GIMP, Blender, Inkscape, Audacity, Draw.io and other desktop apps headless through CLI-Anything harnesses with JSON output, instead of native_app UI control.
prompt:
# CLI-Anything

Bundled upstream source: https://github.com/HKUDS/CLI-Anything (pinned commit 34f519533bc175d2fe287ab8316b0dd99bb9cc43)

Use this skill to produce or edit files with desktop apps such as LibreOffice, GIMP, Blender, Inkscape, Audacity or Draw.io through headless `cli-anything-<app>` harnesses, instead of clicking through the app window with native_app.

Execution workflow:
1. Read `{baseDir}/SKILL.md` for harness discovery, install commands, command patterns and known harness bugs.
2. Find installed harnesses on PATH. If the needed one is missing, ask the user before installing it: installing runs third-party code.
3. Run one `--json` subcommand per run_command call against a project file in the workspace. Never start the interactive REPL.
4. Follow the known-bug workarounds: always pass `-p <preset>` to LibreOffice `export render`, and write computed values instead of Calc formulas.
5. Verify the saved output (probe, re-import or convert) before reporting success.
6. Fall back to native_app only when the user wants the app's window operated or the harness lacks the operation.

Success criteria:
- The requested file exists in the requested format and its content was read back.
- Any install was approved by the user first.
- The answer names the output paths and any harness limits hit.

routing.useWhen: Use when the user wants a file created, edited or exported with a desktop app that has a CLI-Anything harness (LibreOffice Writer/Calc/Impress, GIMP, Blender, Inkscape, Audacity, Draw.io, Kdenlive, Shotcut, Krita, FreeCAD, MuseScore), or in that app's format, without needing to watch its window.
routing.dontUseWhen: Do not use when the user asks to operate or watch the app's window (use native_app), when the task forbids scripting, for Photoshop (use the local Photoshop route), or for plain DOCX/XLSX/PPTX requests that built-in document tools cover.
routing.outputs: Saved files in the requested format produced by the app's own engine, with JSON command results and a readback of the output.
routing.successCriteria: The output file exists in the requested format, its content was verified by probe, re-import or conversion, and any harness install was approved first.

positive: Make a one-page memo in LibreOffice Writer and export it as PDF.
Use GIMP to make a 1200x630 banner with an orange footer bar and a title.
Create a LibreOffice Calc budget sheet and save it as XLSX.
Render this Blender scene to a PNG without opening Blender.
negative: Click through the GIMP menus while I watch so I learn where Filters are.
Edit the text layer in this Photoshop PSD.
Change the font in Pages without using any scripting.
Explain the difference between ODF and OOXML.
